help.alkane.purpose:
On your turn, place the first card of the deck, face-down, on an empty Alkane square.
The slot must be orthogonally adjacent to a card already present, and the square cannot exceed 3x3 in size.
If the card is placed next to a card from the same banner, you recover all adjacent cards from close to that banner.
Otherwise, you recover an adjacent card, and all the cards of the same Banner as it.

tuto.goal: In this game, you'll recruit characters and gain influence among the <0>5 Kingdoms of the Alkane world</0>, in order to conquer more Castles than your opponent.
tuto.castle:
Here are the <0>Castle tokens</0>.
At the end of the game, <0>the player with the most Castles wins</0>.
tuto.bannerdeck:
This is the deck of <0>Banner cards</0>.
<0>The game ends when this deck is empty</0>.
tuto.banner: Each of the 5 Kingdoms has its own banner:
tuto.other.banner: In addition to the 5 Kingdoms, there are 2 other banners:
tuto.alkane:
This is the <0>Alkane square</0>.
On your turn, you must take the first card from the deck and add it, face-down, to this square.
tuto.place: Take the first card from the deck and place it here.
tuto.adjacency: When the card you place is adjacent to a card from the same Banner, <0>you get all the cards adjacent to each other from that Banner</0>.
tuto.actions: With the cards recovered face-down, you have 2 available actions: <0>Recruit</0> or <0>Influence</0>.
tuto.recruit:
Let's start by recruiting a character.
<0>Click on "Recruit" in the header.</0>
tuto.recruit.reveal:
When you recruit, the cards are revealed. Then you choose one of the revealed characters, and place it next to your throne.
<1>Please note: you cannot recruit a character you already have.</1>
tuto.recruit.reptile:
Recruit the Reptile King <2/> by placing him here, next to your throne.
<1>Each character has one or more effects. At any time, you can click on a card to find out its effects.</1>
tuto.opponent.recruit: Your opponent has recruited this character. Now it's your turn.
tuto.non-adjacent:
When the card you place is not adjacent to a card with the same Banner, you must choose a card adjacent to the one placed.
<0>You then recover the chosen card, and all cards with the same Banner.</0>
tuto.feline: Choose this card to pick up the 2 Felines Banner cards <2/>.
tuto.influence:
This time, let's use the cards we've collected to gain influence with the Feline Kingdom <2/>.
<0>Click on "Influence" in the header.</0>
tuto.influence.purpose:
Cards used to influence are never revealed. They are placed in a column in front of you.
<0>Influence is used to activate your characters' effects</0>.
tuto.throne:
Your <0>Throne card</0> also has an effect: you gain <2/><2/> when you reach 3 influences in the Feline Kingdom<3/>.
<1>For your opponent, this is the Raptor Kingdom</1> <4/>.
tuto.opponent.influence: Your opponent has also influenced. Now it's up to you.
tuto.religious: Click on this Religious Order Banner card to take it.
tuto.religious.recruit: Religious Order cards cannot be used to Influence, <0>you can only Recruit</0> them.
tuto.titan:
This card is a <0>Titan</0>!
<0>If you have 5 Titans, you win the game immediately!</0>
tuto.titan.recruit:
When you recruit a Titan, it doesn't go next to your throne, but in this column, next to it.
<0>Recruit the Titan by moving it to this column.</0>
tuto.effect: The Titan has an immediate effect: you gain a Castle token <1/>.
tuto.alkane.refill: If, at the end of a player's turn, there are fewer than 2 cards left in the Alkane square, it is automatically reconstituted with 6 cards, as at the start of the game.
tuto.imperial: Imperial Order cards can either be recruited, <0>or used to Influence any Kingdom</0>, provided you already have influence in that Kingdom.
tuto.help:
You can click on a card at any time to find out what it does.
<0>You can also click on the deck to see all the cards in the game.</0>
tuto.go:
Now it's your turn.
Good luck in your conquest of the 5 Kingdoms!
